name: Wii Sports
short_description: Play tennis, bowling, baseball, golf and boxing by swinging the remote like the real thing.

summary: Play tennis, bowling, baseball, golf and boxing by swinging the remote like the real thing.

identity.core_loop: Swing the remote like a racket, bat or ball; your Mii does the same; score and play again.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Instant and physical; anyone in the room can play.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The sport itself is the readout: ball flight, pins, crowd. A few simple overlays for score.

identity.art_direction: Clean, simple bright figures and fields; Miis with no arms or legs on fielders.

rendering.source: derived from the art note by rendering_notes.RULES

tricks: Simple Mii bodies; fielders have no visible arms or legs and still read as moving
The player's real swing drives the timing of the Mii's swing, so the gesture is the animation
Realism was never the goal: the mind fills in the detail
motion.lesson: Simple bodies let players see themselves; tie the swing animation to the player's own gesture.

sources.title: Iwata Asks: Wii Sports, A Question of Realism

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Simple figures let players see themselves; the gesture is the control and the animation at once.
